title: Strict tensor and Hom representative models
statement: On a site small in the coefficient universe, use the module category and cochain complexes of [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-pc-cochain-complex-modules]. Let I_R be the functorial K-injective replacement of [prop-pur-kinjective-resolutions-exist], with unit eta. Define tensor(T,B)=Tot(single_0(T) tensor B), tensorFixed(B)=tensor(-,B), and homFixed(P)(L)=Hom(P,I_R(L)) using [def-coef-ringed-tensor-hom-model, def-coef-hom-representative-evaluation, def-pur-hom-complex]. tensorGenerator is the actual (0,n)-summand sheafified pure tensor, and homValue is evaluation of the actual (p,p+n)-projection at the identity object of the slice. Normalized(a) means a_T(t tensor f)(x)=eta_{T tensor I_R(L)}(t tensor f(x)) for every section, degree and module T. These are unchanged models extracted from the parent module.

mathlib_searches.query: Strict tensor Hom evaluation natural transformation on complexes of sheaves and filtered colimit continuity of derived Hom
mathlib_searches.results: Returned NatTrans.mapHomologicalComplex, NatTrans.rightDerivedToHomotopyCategory, HomologicalComplex.instHasFilteredColimitsOfSize, HomologicalComplex.isColimitOfEval, sheafHom and colimit homology infrastructure. A finite-free search also returned rTensorHomEquivHomRTensor, lTensorHomEquivHomLTensor, dualTensorHomEquivOfBasis and SheafOfModules.free.
mathlib_searches.verdict: These provide ordinary module adjunction or generic complex-colimit constructions, not the strict coefficient tensor-Hom normalization, finite-free stage roof, or augmentation transport of continuity stated here.
